findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Extract Regex Patterns
 * @description Extracts all string literals used as regular expressions in the re module
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/extract-regex
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-1333
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, DataFlow::Node arg, StrConst regex
where
  call = API::moduleImport("re").getMember(["compile", "search", "match", "fullmatch", "split", "findall", "finditer", "sub", "subn"]).getACall() and
  arg = call.getArg(0) and
  arg.asExpr() = regex
select regex, "Found regex pattern: " + regex.getText()
findings.hypothesis: Complex regular expressions may lead to Denial of Service (ReDoS).

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Identify loops in decode/encode modules
 * @description Find while and for loops in _decode.py and _encode.py to check for potential infinite loops or ReDoS context
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/loops-in-codec
 */
import python

from Stmt s, Module m
where 
  s.getEnclosingModule() = m and
  (m.getName().matches("%_decode%") or m.getName().matches("%_encode%")) and
  (s instanceof While or s instanceof For)
select s, "Loop found in module " + m.getName()
findings.hypothesis: Potential for infinite loops or complexity attacks in decoding/encoding logic.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Inspect URL parsing implementation
 * @description List calls to re module and urllib module in _parse.py to understand implementation
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity info
 * @id py/inspect-parsing-logic
 */
import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call.getLocation().getFile().getShortName() = "_parse.py" and
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("re").getMember(["compile", "match", "search", "split", "sub"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("urllib").getMember(["parse"]).getMember(["urlparse", "urlsplit", "urlunparse", "urlunsplit"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("urllib").getMember(["parse"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Call to parsing/regex function: " + call.getFunction().toString()
findings.hypothesis: The package implements custom URL parsing which might deviate from standard library, creating inconsistencies.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Inspect loops in encode/decode
 * @description Inspect the loop structure in _encode.py and _decode.py to check for inefficient string concatenation or logic errors.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/mdurl-inspect-loops
 * @tags correctness
 *       performance
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from For loop, Stmt s
where
  loop.getScope().getEnclosingModule().getName().matches("mdurl._%") and
  s = loop.getBody().getItem(0)
select loop, "Loop in " + loop.getScope().getEnclosingModule().getName() + " with body starting: " + s.toString()
